# typee — Anki Deck Typing Practice

> typee is a web application that transforms Anki flashcard decks into interactive typing practice sessions. Upload your .apkg file and practice typing your flashcards while tracking WPM (words per minute) and accuracy.

## Core Features

- Upload any Anki deck (.apkg file) and practice typing flashcards
- Real-time WPM and accuracy tracking per session
- Smart Review system using spaced repetition (SRS) for adaptive practice
- Supports any language: Korean, Japanese, Chinese, Spanish, French, and more
- Two practice modes: front-to-back (see word, type meaning) and back-to-front (see meaning, type word)
- 10+ color themes including Catppuccin, Dracula, Nord, Tokyo Night, and more
- Free tier with 1 deck (up to 100 cards) — Pro plan at $5/month for unlimited decks

## How It Works

1. Upload your Anki deck (.apkg file) or try the built-in demo decks
2. Choose a practice mode and start typing — the app shows flashcards one at a time
3. Track your progress with WPM, accuracy, and mastery statistics over time

## Use Cases

- Language learners practicing vocabulary recall through active typing
- Medical students memorizing terminology with Anki decks
- Anyone who wants to reinforce flashcard knowledge through muscle memory
- Supplementing Anki review sessions with active recall through typing

## Technical Details

- Built with Next.js and hosted on Vercel
- Anki deck parsing happens client-side using sql.js (WebAssembly SQLite)
- Authentication via Supabase (Google, Twitter/X, Email)
- Payments via Stripe
